## Overview

From 1990 to 2024, the World Bank approved **`r nrow(projects)` projects** in Costa Rica, 
committing approximately **`r fmt_billions(sum(projects$totalamt[projects$has_financing==TRUE], na.rm=TRUE))`** 
in IBRD lending (nominal US dollars at time of commitment).

This portfolio traces a country navigating structural adjustment, infrastructure investment, fiscal 
reform, environmental leadership, and pandemic response — all while maintaining one of Latin America's 
strongest human development records.

This site presents an exploratory, descriptive analysis of that portfolio. It is not a causal study.

---

### Research Questions

**Primary:** How has the sectoral and thematic distribution of World Bank lending to Costa Rica changed 
from 1990 to 2024, and what do these patterns reveal about evolving development priorities?

**Secondary:** How do changes in development financing relate chronologically to Costa Rica's broader 
economic and social trajectory?

---

### Data Sources

| Source | Description | Coverage |
|--------|-------------|----------|
| World Bank Projects API | Project-level lending records | 72 projects, 1956–2024 |
| World Development Indicators (`wbstats`) | GDP per capita, Gini, life expectancy, literacy | Costa Rica, 1960–2024 |

**Analysis period:** 1990–2024 (25 projects with confirmed approval dates; 16 additional projects 
lack approval dates in the API and cannot be placed in the timeline).
